summarization: The smartphone UI screen displays a list of "Hot Events," which appear to be live streams or broadcasts related to various police departments and emergency services. Each entry includes the name of the department or service, along with the number of listeners currently tuned in. The entries are listed in descending order based on the number of listeners. The screen also features small flag icons next to each entry, indicating the country of the respective department or service. At the bottom of the screen, there is an advertisement banner related to reverse mortgage facts. The top status bar shows standard icons for notifications, battery level, and the current time (7:34).
